# Engine vs direct: what each data path answers

Generated by `go test ./internal/ingest/ -run TestEngineDirectMatrix -update-matrix`.
Do not edit by hand.

Each case projects one planted schema and set of records two ways: the
**engine** path (`mache --out`, every node a row) and the **direct** path (one
row per record, nodes projected on demand). A cell says whether the two
answer the same, and if not, the first difference. This is ADR-0028's first
step for data sources: the list of disagreements, before deciding which
answer is specified. See `engine_direct_matrix_test.go` for each case.

| Case | About | Tree | Content | Definitions | Callers |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| baseline | one record per array element, a list-valued ref, distinct names | agree | agree | agree | agree |
| same-name records | two records render the same directory (mache-299113) | agree | agree | agree | agree |
| missing name field | a record lacks the field its directory name is made of | **differ** (2): `mods/a/<no value>` only on engine (node); … | **differ**: `mods/a/<no value>/doc` only on engine ("anonymous") | **differ**: `mods/a/<no value>` only on engine ([<no value>]) | **differ**: `Named` only on engine ([mods/a/<no value>]) |
| nested selector | a child selects an array inside each record ($.tools[*]) | **differ** (8): `servers/notes` only on engine (node); … | **differ** (3): `servers/notes/read/desc` only on engine ("r"); … | **differ** (3): `servers/notes/read` only on engine ([read]); … | agree |
| templated root | the root node's name is a template | **differ** (4): `x` only on engine (node); … | **differ** (2): `x/doc` only on engine ("dx"); … | agree | agree |
| templated file name | a file's name is a template | **differ** (2): `mods/a/One/note.txt` only on engine (node); … | **differ**: `mods/a/One/note.txt` only on engine ("d1") | agree | agree |
| empty content | a file whose template renders empty for one record | **differ**: `mods/a/Bare/extra` only on direct (node) | **differ**: `mods/a/Bare/extra` only on direct ("") | agree | agree |
| absent content field | a file's template names a field one record does not have | agree | agree | agree | agree |
| dotted names | a name with dots is also defined under its last segment | agree | agree | agree | agree |
| slash in a name | a rendered name contains / and % | agree | agree | agree | agree |
| scalar and numeric refs | refs over a string field and a number | agree | agree | agree | agree |
| missing ref field | a record has no value for the field its refs range over | agree | agree | agree | agree |
